features:
🔥 MUS | Cs Dome — All-in-One Farming Script 🔥

A complete farming script designed to make your gameplay easier, faster, and more convenient.

✅ Auto Farm
Choose your preferred enemy and farm automatically with position locking and auto-attacking.

✅ Auto Boss
Select a boss and difficulty, then summon and farm bosses automatically.

✅ Auto Chest
Automatically locate and collect chests with smart travel and island navigation.

✅ Auto Questline
Complete questlines such as Cursed Orb, Cursed Seal, Shinjuku Showdown, and Naruto Form 1.

✅ Smart Weapon Selection
Automatically choose the best weapon or fighting style based on your stats and damage.

✅ Auto Skills
Automatically use Z / X / C / V skills for faster farming.

✅ Auto Stats
Automatically upgrade your selected stats.

✅ Travel System
Quickly travel to islands, NPCs, and important locations.

✅ Inventory System
Easily view and equip weapons or fighting styles from your inventory.

✅ Feature Requests
Request new features directly through the script.

Enable only the features you need and let MUS | Cs Dome handle the repetitive farming for you. 🚀
